description: Preview the credit cost of a reveal. Nothing is charged and nothing is revealed. Returns the cost of each action (details, ceo, marketing, ecommerce) for the selected stores.

selection.description: The stores to price. Pass either "ids", or "tab" with optional "filters" and "deselected".

deselected.description: Store ids to leave out of a tab selection.

filters.description: Filters for the tab, in the searchStores format.

column.description: A column key, for example "Industry" or "Total Traffic". Call searchStores with includeColumns true to see all keys.

operator.description: Text columns: contains, notContains, is, isNot. Number columns: gt, gte, lt, lte, eq. Date columns: is, isBefore, isAfter, isWithinLast. Tag columns: hasAny, notHas. All types: isEmpty, isNotEmpty, exists, notExists.

value.description: The value to compare. A number for number columns, a YYYY-MM-DD date for isBefore and isAfter, a number of days for isWithinLast. Leave it out for isEmpty, isNotEmpty, exists and notExists.

ids.description: Store ids (the storeId field of a searchStores row).

tab.description: all, revealed, set:{id} or watchlist:{id}. Prices every store in the tab after the filters.

name: getRevealCost
title: Get reveal cost
